title: The leaf behind the desk
author: Sergeant Aldric Mooring
notes: Bible 6.1 quest 3 (The Watch Still Stands; mw-e39.11): the page the damp took from book-keepers-log, found wedged behind the keeper's desk. Gives the watchword, which is the 'any class' solution, and says what ends the watch (the bell, relief by a knight, or the order being unmade). Does not contradict book-keepers-log: Day 40 gave the stands the order; this is Day 41 and the last day.

pages.text:
Day 41 alone. If anyone reads this, the men on the stairs will let you pass if you say the word. The word is Vespers-and-home. I chose it so they would remember what they are waiting for.

The order is: hold the tower. It does not say until when. A relieving officer can end it, or a bell from the tower, or someone who unmakes it. I have not the heart to unmake it myself.

If you are a knight, say it properly. They will know the old words.
